card.name: Group nouns in history, before 'under' a leader
card.fires_on: The last word of a group or party name in historical text, such as Liberals, forces, troops or government. It sits where 'under [leader]' or 'led by' could come next.

modes.label: Political party or government
modes.description: A party or government named in a dated political timeline, just before a leader is named.
modes.example: 1922 -<< Liberals>>, led by William Lyon Mackenzie King

modes.label: Military forces
modes.description: An army or troop word in a war narrative, where a commander could follow.
modes.example: It's 1864 and the Union<< forces>> are ready to make a final drive into

modes.label: Other historic group
modes.description: A band or army group in a historical account.
modes.example: In the spring of 1847 a pioneer<< band>> left Winter Quarters to cross the Plains

card.writes: It adds the word 'under' (as in 'under the command of') as a likely next word.
card.plain: It fires on a group in a history passage, where the text is likely to go on with 'under' a leader's name.
